note: Within-city slopes on log market access. Weighted two-way fixed effects, city-and-language and period effects. se is clustered by city. se_bracket is the larger of that and the Conley standard error at 250 km. size_in_sd is the slope times one within-city standard deviation of log market access, in standard deviations of the outcome.

authority_difference.note: Fragmented authority minus unitary authority, from one regression on both pools with language-by-period effects.

provinces.note: Doctrine distinctiveness without Leipzig, Venice, Antwerp, Paris, and Madrid. reference is what a city is measured against: all other cities of its language, the other provincial cities, or the center alone.

through_diversity.note: Novelty and bridging on doctrine diversity. direct: on diversity alone. joint: diversity and log market access together. iv: diversity instrumented by log market access. se_bracket is the standard error the paper quotes.

magnitudes.note: Not in the paper. From the explorations of 17 November 2026. shares: percent of a city's doctrine titles that are novel, bridging, both, or either, before and after a rise of one within-city standard deviation of log market access (0.151). science: titles in the catalog's science, mathematics, astrology, and botany classes.
